dialogues.value: Great, you're still around 305. Thought we lost you with the communications. The new pulse bullet you bought should come in handy at shooting down those stalctites. Navigate the area carefully, theres something big down there and its messing with our coms.
Do I get a bonus for all this money I was required to spend?
What was that? You're cutting out again.
Alright, 305. We have sent the vendor again this time. Meet up with him if you need any assistance and pick up any of the beacons that are still available.
I better be getting compensated for all this stuff I've had to buy Captain.
We'll sort that out with your bonus when you get back on board the ship. The Vendor should have access to a new area for 100 credits.
More spending! I better be getting that bonus.
Ah what... it looks like you're cutting out again. Good luck out there 305.
Oh hey, it's me, your favourite bin man! You remember the deal from last time.
You're going to need pay up yet again if you want what I got. Don't worry, this time its worth it. This part right here should obliterate the big guy down there.
It's yours if you can part with, lets say, 500 credits. I sure do hope you've got enough. Otherwise, go down there and face him yourself.
Really? More money? You're real greedy.
